rationale: Builds directly on the recurrent-tail QK winner by spending the next run on a byte reallocation that stays inside the strongest local family. The closest recent export-path miss moved the penultimate recurrent block from QK-only to full QKV rescue while dropping one projection block and still left substantial artifact headroom. This variant keeps that stronger two-pass recurrent attention path, then spends part of the recovered budget on the final recurrent block's `mlp.fc.weight`, which is both the last large expansion matrix before the logits and the only MLP expansion reused by the winning recurrent tail. Training dynamics, wallclock behavior, quant-aware timing, and the exact `final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact` path remain unchanged; only the FP16 keep allocation shifts toward tensors that are reused twice in the proven tail and closest to the scored output.
title: Full Recurrent QKV Plus Final Recurrent MLP Expansion
